origin.says: From 凱: 豈 (a drum, first form of the word) with 几 (small table); one reading takes 豈 as the meaning and 几 as the sound, another the reverse. First meant victory music. The simplified form writes 豈 as 岂.

ety.hint: A stone 石 like amber 珀; 珀 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) and 石 (stone) for the meaning, with 白 (white) as the sound: a green-blue jade-like stone, then blue-green. One reading takes 珀 (amber) as one sound unit.

ety.hint: Many small 少 stones 石; 少 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 少 (few, small) as the sound and hint: tiny stones, sand. It began as a variant of 沙 (sand).

奸.def: crafty, dishonest, selfish; evil, villainous; adultery

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 干 (offend) as the sound: crafty, wicked. The simplified form also took over 姦 (three 女 women: adultery).

奸.name: traitor

孟.def: first in a series; great, eminent

ety.hint: A child 子 sitting on a throne 皿

origin.says: 子 (child) for the meaning plus 皿 (dish) as the sound: the eldest son, first in a series; hence great.

孟.name: eldest son

耸.def: to excite, to urge; to raise; to shrug; lofty, towering

origin.says: Simplified from 聳: 從 (follow) as the sound, now 从, plus 耳 (ear) for the meaning; first deaf, later to stand tall, to shrug, to startle.

耸.name: shrug

ety.hint: Letters placed in a container 凵

origin.says: Originally a drawing of an arrow stored upside down in a case with a handle: a container, hence a case, and a letter sent in an envelope. The modern shape has broken up the picture.

熨.def: to press, to iron; an iron

呛.def: choking, as by smoke; something that irritates the nose or throat

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 仓 (granary) as the sound: something that catches in the throat. Simplified from 嗆, where the sound part 倉 (granary) was shortened to 仓.

呛.name: choking smoke

ety.hint: A pond 氵 growing scum 虫

origin.says: From 濁: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 蜀 (silkworm) as the sound: muddy water. An old popular form cut 蜀 down to 虫 (insect).
Traditional 瓊: 玉 (jade, written 𤣩) for the meaning plus 夐 (far) as the sound, a fine red jade. The simplified form replaced the complex sound part with 京 (capital).
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 相 (mutual) as the sound: the Xiang river, hence short for Hunan.
缶 (earthen pot) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: a big earthen jar or vat.

ety.hint: A clay 土 oven 火

origin.says: 火 (fire) next to 土 (earth): a fire in a clay stove. It is an old popular form now standing for the complex 竈.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 由 (from) as the sound: a bamboo flute.

蓬.def: disheveled, unkempt; a type of raspberry

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 逢 (meet) as the sound: a bushy weed that tumbles in the wind, hence tangled and unkempt.

蓬.name: tumbleweed

岔.def: to diverge, to branch; junction, fork in the road

ety.hint: A road being split 分 by a mountain 山

origin.says: 分 (to split) over 山 (mountain): where a mountain path divides, a fork or branch.

岔.name: junction

拄.def: post; to lean on; to prod, to ridicule

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 主 (master) as the sound: to lean on a stick, to prop; the same word as 柱 (pillar).

拄.name: lean on stick

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 令 (command) as the sound: the tinkling of jade ornaments.
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: first 'to think', then borrowed for 'only, but'.

搀.def: to mix; to support, to sustain, to lend a hand

origin.says: From 攙: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 毚 (crafty hare) as the sound: to support by the arm; to mix in. 毚 was replaced by the simpler 𫥎.

搀.name: lend an arm

origin.says: Simplified from 閘: 门 (gate) for the meaning plus 甲 (shell armor) as the sound: a sluice gate. 門 became its cursive shape 门.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 圭 (jade tablet) as the sound: a modern character for silicon, taken over from Japanese usage.

锯.def: a saw; to saw, to amputate

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 居 (reside) as the sound: a metal saw. Simplified from 鋸, with the metal part 釒 written in its short form 钅.

锯.name: saw

ety.hint: Bandits mugging 攴 a person 元 in his home 宀

origin.says: 宀 (roof) over 元 (a person's head) next to 攴 (hand holding a stick): someone beaten under their own roof, a bandit, invader.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 最 (most) as the sound: what the fingers pick up, 'a pinch'.

靡.def: to scatter, to disperse; to divide

origin.says: 麻 (hemp) as the sound plus 非 (not; two wings turned apart) for the meaning of spreading apart: to scatter, to bend down before the wind, to waste.

靡.name: sweep away

嘟.def: the sound of a horn tooting

蛀.def: termite, bookworm; to bore, to eat into

origin.says: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 主 (master) as the sound: insects that bore into wood or books, to eat into.

蛀.name: woodworm

ety.hint: The jaw in 夹 the head 页; 夹 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 页 (head) for the meaning plus 夹 (squeeze between) as the sound: the part of the head on each side, the cheek. Simplified from 頰 (夾 → 夹, 頁 → 页).
犭 (animal) for the meaning plus 袁 (long robe) as the sound: the ape.

穗.def: ear of grain; fringe, tassel; Guangzhou

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 惠 (kindness) as the sound: an ear of grain, also a tassel.

穗.name: grain ear

ety.hint: Food 饣 stuffed in a hole 臽; 臽 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 餡: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 臽 (a pit) as the sound: the stuffing put inside food. 食 is written 饣.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 叔 (uncle) as the sound: clear, pure water, hence good and virtuous, used of women.
扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 夸 (big, boast) as the sound: to carry hung on the arm or shoulder.

腌.def: to salt, to cure; to pickle, to marinate

ety.hint: Meat ⺼ left 奄 in salt; 奄 also provides the pronunciation
A drill 丵 making a hole 凵

origin.says: An old form showing a chisel 丵 (chisel tool) working in a hollow 凵 (pit): to chisel, to bore. 鑿 later added 金 (metal) and more; the simplified form goes back to the short old form.
辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 于 (at) as the sound: a winding, roundabout road; hence roundabout thinking, pedantic.

囗.in: 国因回团图围园困固烟圈墙姻圆擅恩菌囚捆鄙徊颤咽囤茵圃禀凛檀

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 澡 (bath) as the sound: water plants, algae; also ornate wording. Originally written 薻.

擤.def: to blow the nose with fingers

ety.hint: To use a hand 扌 to blow the nose 鼻
The sun 日 hidden behind a cloud 云

origin.says: A tied bundle 束 (bundle) with two marks inside, pointing at what is picked out of the bag: its first meaning was 'to pick, select' (now 拣). It was later used for a note or letter. Sources call the origin partly unclear.

瞩.def: to focus on, to stare at, to watch carefully

origin.says: Simplified from 矚: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 屬 (belong), simplified to 属, as the sound: to fix the eyes on, to gaze at.

瞩.name: stare at

ety.hint: A bird 鸟 roosting in a tree 木

origin.says: 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 我 (I) as the sound: moth.

ety.hint: A similar 肖 person 亻; 肖 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 肖 (resemble) as the sound: good-looking, pretty.
Simplified from 靂: 雨 (rain, weather) for the meaning plus 歷 (pass through) as the sound: a crash of thunder. 歷 was replaced by 历 (history).
雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 辟 (law) as the sound: a crashing thunderclap in a storm.
Simplified from 蠶, a complex form with 虫 (insect) below. The new form is 天 (sky) as the sound plus 虫 (insect) for the meaning: the silkworm.
厂 (cliff) as the sound plus 亻 (person) and 隹 (bird) for the meaning: the wild goose, a bird that flies in orderly lines like people.

ety.hint: A place 阝 on a hill 丘; 丘 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 连 (link) as the sound: the lotus. Simplified from 蓮.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 耦 (pair of ploughmen) as the sound: the lotus root.

冶.def: to smelt, to fuse metals, to cast

origin.says: One reading: metal ingots (now 冫) with a ladle and a mouth, to cast metal; the ladle and mouth merged into 台 (platform), which also gives the sound. The early forms are disputed.

冶.name: smelting

origin.says: 艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 癸 (tenth stem) as the sound: a mallow, now the sunflower.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 族 (clan) as the sound and sense: bamboo growing in a thick cluster.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 黄 (yellow) as the sound: the thin bamboo tongue in a reed instrument; now also a metal spring.

ety.hint: Shade 阴 provided by a tree 艹; 阴 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plant) plus 陰 (shade), which gives sound and meaning: the shade of trees, shelter. Simplified from 蔭, with 阴 for 陰.
Simplified from 鈕: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 丑 (clawed hand) as the sound: a metal knob or button.

ety.hint: A happy 喜 sound 口; 喜 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 喜 (joy) as sound and meaning: the sound of a happy mouth, giggling.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 隹 (short-tailed bird) as the sound: a wooden mallet; from its knobby shape, also a vertebra.

One reading: 门 (gate) + 王 (king), the king staying inside the palace gate on the extra day or month of the calendar; another takes 门 as the sound. Hence intercalary, extra. Simplified from 閏, with 門 written 门.
